config.hypothesis: Field-condition supervision teaches a randomly initialized CNN to recognize tomato conditions on new capture groups beyond the effect of an equal dose of master images.

selection.primary: Checkpoint selection uses the equal source mean of provided-tomato macro-F1 on five represented Pakistan labels and two represented Sheikh labels. Each source retains all ten eligible tomato conditions. Research promotion additionally requires a joint gain with all 177 outputs and a full-master check. Banu is diagnostic.
selection.constraints: Same initialization per arm and seed, master train originals, label counts, batch order, training augmentation, loss, device and D4 policy. Replace each supplemental slot with a same-label master replay for control. Use the same fixed 50:50 condition blend in both arms. The joint rule activates only when the incumbent's top category is tomato and preserves the total mass assigned to tomato.
selection.stop: Complete both seeds for each arm. Publish every comparison including a failure. A joint candidate that passes still needs new independent confirmation before any change to the app.
